name: Dynamic AJAX Product Filters for WooCommerce
author: Plugincy

sections.description:
Supercharge your WooCommerce store with fast, flexible, and SEO-optimized filtering.

Give your customers exactly what they’re looking for — with real-time filtering, rich UI controls, and performance-first features.

Transform the shopping experience on your WooCommerce store with Dynamic AJAX Product Filters – a fast, flexible, and SEO-friendly solution for real-time product discovery. This powerful advanced product filters system for WooCommerce updates results instantly without reloading the page, keeping users engaged and reducing bounce rates. Customers can filter by category, tags, attributes, price, rating, search, brand, stock status, author, sale status, length, width, height, weight, SKU, product ID, discount, and date ranges. Pro extends this with selected custom taxonomies, custom fields, featured products, product exclusions, full desktop layouts, and WPML-compatible filter strings.

The Pro upgrade also adds selected custom taxonomy filters, featured product filtering, brand taxonomy mapping, product exclusion rules, dimension visibility and ordering controls, advanced pagination modes, AJAX sorting, custom product loop selectors, shortcode builder options, and WPML-compatible filter strings.

» Buy Pro | » More info | » Demos | » Docs

⭐ Key Features at a Glance:

Dynamic AJAX Product Filters for WooCommerce comes packed with powerful features to help customers discover products quickly and effortlessly.

✅️ Real-Time AJAX Product Filtering – Instantly update product results as customers apply filters, eliminating page reloads and providing a smooth browsing experience.
✅️ Advanced Multi-Filter System – Allow shoppers to combine multiple filters simultaneously including categories, attributes, price ranges, tags, ratings, stock status, sale status, dimensions, SKU, date ranges, and Pro custom fields/custom taxonomies.
✅️ Flexible Filter Placement Options – Display filters in sidebars, top bars, widgets, product grids, page builders, or shortcodes; Pro unlocks the full six desktop layouts: Sidebar, Top View, Top View Wrap, Popup, Popup Horizontal Wrap, and Drawer.
✅️ Modern Filter UI Controls – Use a wide range of filter styles including Select2 dropdowns, checkboxes, radio buttons, price sliders, button checks, and robust visual swatches (image, color, borderless, circular).
✅️ SEO-Friendly Filter URLs – Generate crawlable URLs using query strings or clean permalinks to improve search engine indexing.
✅️ Mobile-Optimized Filter Layouts – Provide 4 mobile styles (Style 1, Style 2, Popup, and Drawer) with customizable breakpoints and touch-friendly controls.
✅️ Builder & Theme Integration – Includes Elementor widgets, Gutenberg blocks, WordPress widgets, shortcodes, WooCommerce archive selectors, and product-loop hooks for Divi, Beaver Builder, Oxygen, and Bricks.
✅️ Advanced Product Metadata Filters – Filter products using SKU, product ID, brand, author, discount percentage, and Pro custom fields/custom taxonomies.
✅️ Powerful Filter Logic – Supports AND / OR filtering logic, multi-select filters, single-select filters, and default pre-selected filter values.
✅️ Performance-Optimized Architecture – Designed with efficient queries, AJAX fragments, caching systems, and optimized filtering logic for fast performance.
✅️ Pro Catalog Controls – Upgrade to manage selected custom taxonomies, featured product filters, brand taxonomies, product exclusions, dimension visibility/order, and custom field exclusions.
✅️ Builder-Ready Shortcode Controls – Use the shortcode builder with core layout, selector, pagination, mobile, and URL settings; Pro unlocks drawer, collapse, redirect, operator, and the full desktop layout set.
✅️ Advanced Pagination & Sorting Controls – Support advanced pagination modes, selector mapping, and Pro AJAX sorting/result-count/browser-history controls.
✅️ Modern Pro UI Variants – Upgrade for chips, button chips, steppers, modern dropdowns, rating sliders, chart price sliders, SKU search buttons, discount sliders, and calendar-style date filters.
✅️ Pro Multilingual Filter Support – Upgrade for WPML-ready option strings, translated taxonomy data, language-aware filter caches, and current-language frontend values.

🎯 Core Filtering Features:

The AJAX Product Filter for WooCommerce gives customers powerful tools to refine their search instantly. From categories, price, rating, size, attributes, and tags to stock status and custom fields, shoppers can apply multiple filters at once – without page reloads. This real-time filtering ensures a faster, smoother, and more enjoyable shopping experience that keeps customers engaged and drives more conversions.

✅️ Supercharged AJAX Filtering Engine

Experience lightning-fast product filtering with advanced AJAX technology. As customers apply filters, product listings update instantly – no full-page reloads, no delays. Just smooth, fluid filtering that keeps shoppers engaged and improves usability.

  • Real-time results Instant updates with every filter click or selection. Keep shoppers focused and prevent drop-offs with instant feedback.
  • Smooth pagination and sorting Smooth pagination and sorting without page reloads. Deliver an uninterrupted flow that makes browsing effortless.
  • Custom loader effects Maintain a consistent, branded shopping experience. Reinforce your brand while ensuring checkout stays smooth and professional.
  • Advanced pagination modes Choose number pagination, number with previous/next, load more, or infinite scroll with custom trigger selectors.
  • AJAX sorting and result counts Keep ordering controls, product counts, and product grids synchronized without page reloads.
  • Browser history step navigation Let shoppers move back and forward through filter states cleanly.

✅️ Powerful Filter Options – From Basic to Advanced

Give your customers the tools to refine their shopping journey with ease. From everyday basics to advanced search options, the AJAX Product Filter for WooCommerce ensures they find the right products faster:

  • Product Basics Filters
    Help users quickly discover what they need with simple, effective filters:
  • Filter by Price: Let shoppers set budgets and view products within their range.
  • Filter by Rating: Showcase products with top reviews for faster, trusted decisions.
  • Filter by Category, Tags, or Attributes: Narrow results by size, color, material, or custom attributes.
  • Keyword-Based Search Filter: Allow instant text-based searches across product titles.
  • Pro Search Scope & Auto Suggestions: Upgrade to search content, excerpts, SKU, tags, categories, attributes, authors, and brands with optional auto suggestions.
  • Pro Featured Product Filter: Highlight WooCommerce featured products inside AJAX filtered results.
  • Product Metadata & Pro Custom Field Filters
    Refine searches with filters based on product metadata and unique identifiers:
  • Filter by Brand – Let shoppers browse by their favorite brands.
  • Filter by Author – Perfect for books, digital products, or creator-based items.
  • Filter by SKU – Help customers quickly find specific products by code.
  • Pro Custom Meta Field Filters – Add store-specific filter options for unique product details.
  • Filter by Product ID – Let customers or staff find exact products quickly.
  • Pro Custom Taxonomies – Add AJAX filters for product taxonomies created by themes, plugins, or custom code.
  • Pro Brand Taxonomy Mapping – Auto-detect or manually choose WooCommerce brands, PWB brands, YITH brands, BeRocket brands, JetEngine brands, suppliers, manufacturers, product_brand, product_brands, pa_brand, or other product taxonomies.
  • Pro Selected Custom Taxonomies – Control exactly which product taxonomies appear in the filter form.
  • Attribute & Pro Custom Field Exclusions – Hide specific attributes or custom fields from filter generation when they should not appear on the storefront.
  • Stock & Availability Filters
    Highlight availability, promotions, and active deals with smart filtering:
  • Filter by Stock Status – Show products that are in stock, out of stock, or on backorder.
  • Filter by Sale Status – Display only items currently on sale or running promotions.
  • Filter by Discount Percentage – Showcase products with specific discounts for deal seekers.
  • Pro Product Exclusion Rules – Exclude specific products, categories, tags, brands, or custom taxonomy terms from filtered results.
  • Product Dimensions & Weight Filters
    Let customers narrow products using measurable attributes:
  • Filter by Length, Width, Height – Ideal for furniture, apparel, or equipment.
  • Filter by Weight – Useful for shipping-sensitive or size-dependent purchases.
  • Dimension Visibility & Order – Choose which dimension filters appear and arrange length, width, height, and weight in the best order for your catalog.
  • Dynamic Dimension Ranges – Use range controls for measurable product data and variation-aware values where available.
  • Date-Based Filters
    Help users discover products based on time-sensitive availability:
  • Show products from: Today, This Week, This Month, This Year.
  • Specific Date Range (From–To): Perfect for scheduling, seasonal, or limited-time products.

✅️ Multiple URL & AJAX-Based Filtering Methods

Deliver ultimate flexibility for developers and a smooth shopping experience for customers with filtering formats designed for SEO, speed, and usability.

1. Query string-based filters

  • Format: ?filters=brand,size,color
  • Example: ?filters=adidas,l,blue

2. Query String Filtering with Key Prefixes

  • Format: ?filters=1&brand=adidas&size=l&color=blue

3. Clean Permalink-Based Filtering

  • Format: /filters/brand/size/color
  • Example: /filters/adidas/large/blue

4. Permalink Filtering with Key-Value Pairs

  • Format: /filters/brand=adidas/size=l/color=blue

5. AJAX-Based Filtering (No URL Change)

  • Dynamic filtering via AJAX without changing the URL – perfect for SPAs and performance-driven stores.

6. Real-Time Dynamic AJAX Filters

  • Instant filtering as users select options – no reloads, real-time updates for a smoother UX.

Advanced URL and Redirect Controls

  • Manage filter-word prefixes, permalink prefixes, attribute-type permalinks, clean route parsing for category/tag/attribute/brand archives, and redirect settings when filtered products are missing.

✅️ Full Widget & Shortcode Support

Available Shortcodes
Easily add filters anywhere on your site using simple, flexible shortcodes:

  • [plugincy_filters] – Display the complete filter set.
  • [plugincy_filters_single name=”attribute_slug”] – Show a single, button-style filter for attributes like size or color.
  • [plugincy_filters_selected] – Highlight active filters in a clean chips-style widget.

Shortcode Builder & Attributes

  • Build [plugincy_filters] visually in the admin shortcode builder, Elementor, or Gutenberg.
  • Configure layout, mobile_responsive, product_selector, pagination_selector, per_page, category, tag, attribute, terms, and URL settings; Pro unlocks drawer side, collapsible desktop filters, close-on-apply behavior, operators, redirects, and the full six desktop layouts.
  • Use full filter, single filter, and selected filter widgets or blocks with separate style controls.

Built-in Dynamic AJAX Filter Widget & Block
Get full widget and block support with seamless integration for Elementor and the Block Editor. Unlock advanced customization options for greater design flexibility and effortless placement of filters across your store.

✅️ Mobile-Friendly & Responsive by Design

Optimized for users on the go, our filters ensure smooth shopping on any device:

  • Choose from 4 mobile friendly styles:
    • Style 1, Style 2, Popup, and Drawer
  • Touch-friendly controls for better mobile filtering experience
  • Smooth transitions and easy navigation across all screen sizes
  • Set drawer side, sidebar-on-top behavior, mobile breakpoint, and close drawer/popup after apply.

✅️ Built-in SEO Optimization

Unlike many AJAX-based plugins, Plugincy’s Product Filters for WooCommerce are SEO-ready:

  • Create SEO-friendly, crawlable permalinks enriched with relevant keywords
  • Customize SEO titles, meta descriptions, and metadata for filtered pages
  • Enable anchor-based navigation for better accessibility and rankings
  • Use AJAX-only mode when SEO isn’t needed (e.g., single-page apps)

🎨 Advanced Filter Design & UI:

Build a sleek, modern, and fully customizable filtering interface that not only enhances the user experience but also blends seamlessly with your WooCommerce store’s design.

  • Multiple UI Elements
    Offer dynamic and flexible filtering through a variety of interface options:

    • Dropdowns

  • Expanded Pro Style Variants

    • Input price range, chart slider, price range button, and price range card styles.
    • Color circle, color value, color swatch label, image value, button check, icon card, icon list, icon chip, icon badge, and icon-only styles.
    • Dimension range, compact dimension cards, SKU search buttons, SKU icon search, discount sliders, and modern calendar, quick-pick, dual-calendar, and stacked-list date layouts.

  • Upgraded Dropdowns with Select2
    Make filters smarter with advanced, searchable, and styled dropdowns that simplify product discovery and improve navigation.

  • New Filter Styles
    Fresh, modern, and user-friendly filter designs that adapt to your store’s theme for a cohesive look.

  • Collapsible Widget Options
    Keep filters tidy by grouping long lists into expandable sections, improving readability and navigation.

  • Customizable Filter Widgets via Elementor & Gutenberg
    Easily manage filter order, visibility, and styling directly within Elementor or the WordPress Block Editor—no coding required.

  • Advanced Term Controls
    Order terms by default, alphabetic, numeric, month/year, menu order, or count; choose ascending/descending order; include/exclude terms; choose AND/OR logic; show product counts and tooltips; and place term search in the title bar, below the title, or after all terms.

  • Filter Visibility Control
    Decide where filters appear—globally or on specific pages—for total placement control.

  • Different Filters for Different Pages
    Assign unique filter sets per page, category, or product type for tailored experiences.

  • Customizable Loader
    Choose from built-in loading animations or use Pro custom HTML/CSS for a branded touch.

⚡ Compatibility & Performance:

Deliver blazing-fast filtering without sacrificing compatibility. This plugin is optimized for speed, SEO, and seamless integration with any modern WooCommerce setup.

  • Speed Optimized
    Designed for AJAX updates with configurable selectors, cached filter data, and admin controls that help keep storefront filtering responsive.

  • Works with Custom & Premium Themes
    Seamlessly integrates with any WooCommerce-compatible theme, whether free, custom-built, or premium.

  • Built-in WordPress Widget Support
    Easily add filters to sidebars, footers, or any widget-ready area for flexible placement across your store.

  • Loop and Builder Selectors
    Set product, pagination, sorting, result-count, and product-shortcode selectors so filters work with WooCommerce archives, Elementor loops, Gutenberg blocks, shortcode grids, and custom theme loops.

  • Storefront UX Controls
    Use apply/reset behavior, default selected values, remove out-of-stock products, custom no-products text, and Select2 placeholder text controls. Pro unlocks wait cursor, overlay, smart auto scroll, AJAX pagination, AJAX sorting, and browser history step navigation.

  • Large Catalog Cache Handling
    Use database-safe cache handling, background batched cache rebuilds, Action Scheduler support, WP-Cron fallback, cache status tools, and manual refresh controls for stores with large product catalogs.

  • Accessibility and Pro Multilingual Support
    Use accessibility hardening for dynamic filter updates. Pro adds WPML-ready strings, translated taxonomy data, language-aware filter caches, and current-language frontend values.

  • Search by Text Field
    Enable users to refine results by entering keywords directly into a search field within the filter panel.

🔓 Pro Features – Unlock the Full Power:

Take your WooCommerce store to the next level with advanced filtering tools and enterprise-ready features available in the Pro version. Get more control, more flexibility, and more performance with powerful upgrades designed for serious store owners:

    Choose which custom product taxonomies appear in the filter form and keep storefront filters focused on the terms that matter.

  • Brand Taxonomy Auto/Manual Mapping
    Auto-detect or manually map brand filters from WooCommerce, Perfect Brands for WooCommerce, YITH, BeRocket, JetEngine, supplier, manufacturer, product_brand, product_brands, pa_brand, and other product taxonomies.

  • Featured Product Filter
    Let shoppers filter directly to WooCommerce featured products and promoted catalog items.

  • Product Exclusion Rules
    Exclude specific products, categories, tags, brands, or custom taxonomy terms from filtered AJAX results.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard:

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “Dynamic AJAX Product Filters for WooCommerce”
  3. Activate the plugin from your Plugins page
  4. Configure filter settings in the WooCommerce settings panel under “Product Filters.”

Process of Using AJAX Product Filters for WooCommerce Store

Step 1: Configure Product Filters
1. Navigate to Admin → Product Filters → Form Manage.
2. Enable the options for Show Categories, Show Attributes, Show Tags, Show Price Range, and Show Rating as needed.
3. Choose a filtering method in the use URL-Based Filter section:
– With Query String (e.g., ?filters)
– With Permalinks
– With Ajax

Step 2: Add Products and Customize Filters
1. Add WooCommerce products, categories, attributes, and tags.
2. Use the [plugincy_filters] shortcode to display filtering options wherever needed.
3. Customize the filter widget styles via Admin → Product Filters → Form Style tab.

Recommended Requirements

  • WordPress 5.9 or higher
  • WooCommerce 3.6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.0 or higher
sections.faq:
Is This Plugin Compatible With My Theme?

Yes. Dynamic AJAX Product Filters for WooCommerce works with standard WooCommerce archive markup and includes selectors for custom product loops, pagination, sorting, and result-count areas.

How Can I Configure the Filter Options?

Simply go to the WordPress admin, locate the “Product Filters” section, and customize the filter options based on your store requirements.

Does the Plugin Support Custom Permalinks?

Yes, the plugin supports custom permalink structures, allowing filtered pages to align with your store’s permalink setup.

Is the Plugin Compatible With Variable Products?

Yes. Dynamic AJAX Product Filters for WooCommerce supports filtering variable products by attributes and supported variation-aware product data where WooCommerce exposes it.

Does This Plugin Support Shortcode Usage?

Yes. Use [plugincy_filters] for the full filter set, [plugincy_filters_single name="pa_color"] for one filter group, and [plugincy_filters_selected] for selected-filter chips. The shortcode builder supports core layout/mobile/selector/URL options, while Pro unlocks drawer, popup, redirect, operator, and full desktop layout controls.

Can I filter by custom taxonomies, brands, featured products, and product exclusions?

Yes. The Pro version supports selected custom taxonomy filters, featured product filters, brand taxonomy auto/manual mapping, and exclusion rules for products, categories, tags, brands, and custom taxonomy terms.

Does it support advanced pagination, AJAX sorting, and custom theme selectors?

Yes. Pro supports numbered pagination, numbered pagination with previous/next, load more, infinite scroll, AJAX sorting, result-count selectors, product shortcode selectors, and custom selectors for WooCommerce loops or builder loops.

Can I build filters with Elementor, Gutenberg, and shortcodes?

Yes. You can use Elementor widgets, Gutenberg blocks, [plugincy_filters], [plugincy_filters_single], [plugincy_filters_selected], and the shortcode builder with layout, mobile, redirect, selector, operator, and URL settings.

Does the Pro version support WPML?

Yes. Pro includes WPML compatibility for saved option strings, translated taxonomy/product filter data, language-aware filter caches, and current-language frontend labels.

short_description: Dynamic AJAX Product Filters allow shoppers to quickly filter WooCommerce products by categories, attributes, prices, and more.
description:
Supercharge your WooCommerce store with fast, flexible, and SEO-optimized filtering.

Give your customers exactly what they’re looking for — with real-time filtering, rich UI controls, and performance-first features.

Transform the shopping experience on your WooCommerce store with Dynamic AJAX Product Filters – a fast, flexible, and SEO-friendly solution for real-time product discovery. This powerful advanced product filters system for WooCommerce updates results instantly without reloading the page, keeping users engaged and reducing bounce rates. Customers can filter by category, tags, attributes, price, rating, search, brand, stock status, author, sale status, length, width, height, weight, SKU, product ID, discount, and date ranges. Pro extends this with selected custom taxonomies, custom fields, featured products, product exclusions, full desktop layouts, and WPML-compatible filter strings.

The Pro upgrade also adds selected custom taxonomy filters, featured product filtering, brand taxonomy mapping, product exclusion rules, dimension visibility and ordering controls, advanced pagination modes, AJAX sorting, custom product loop selectors, shortcode builder options, and WPML-compatible filter strings.

» Buy Pro | » More info | » Demos | » Docs

⭐ Key Features at a Glance:

Dynamic AJAX Product Filters for WooCommerce comes packed with powerful features to help customers discover products quickly and effortlessly.

✅️ Real-Time AJAX Product Filtering – Instantly update product results as customers apply filters, eliminating page reloads and providing a smooth browsing experience.
✅️ Advanced Multi-Filter System – Allow shoppers to combine multiple filters simultaneously including categories, attributes, price ranges, tags, ratings, stock status, sale status, dimensions, SKU, date ranges, and Pro custom fields/custom taxonomies.
✅️ Flexible Filter Placement Options – Display filters in sidebars, top bars, widgets, product grids, page builders, or shortcodes; Pro unlocks the full six desktop layouts: Sidebar, Top View, Top View Wrap, Popup, Popup Horizontal Wrap, and Drawer.
✅️ Modern Filter UI Controls – Use a wide range of filter styles including Select2 dropdowns, checkboxes, radio buttons, price sliders, button checks, and robust visual swatches (image, color, borderless, circular).
✅️ SEO-Friendly Filter URLs – Generate crawlable URLs using query strings or clean permalinks to improve search engine indexing.
✅️ Mobile-Optimized Filter Layouts – Provide 4 mobile styles (Style 1, Style 2, Popup, and Drawer) with customizable breakpoints and touch-friendly controls.
✅️ Builder & Theme Integration – Includes Elementor widgets, Gutenberg blocks, WordPress widgets, shortcodes, WooCommerce archive selectors, and product-loop hooks for Divi, Beaver Builder, Oxygen, and Bricks.
✅️ Advanced Product Metadata Filters – Filter products using SKU, product ID, brand, author, discount percentage, and Pro custom fields/custom taxonomies.
✅️ Powerful Filter Logic – Supports AND / OR filtering logic, multi-select filters, single-select filters, and default pre-selected filter values.
✅️ Performance-Optimized Architecture – Designed with efficient queries, AJAX fragments, caching systems, and optimized filtering logic for fast performance.
✅️ Pro Catalog Controls – Upgrade to manage selected custom taxonomies, featured product filters, brand taxonomies, product exclusions, dimension visibility/order, and custom field exclusions.
✅️ Builder-Ready Shortcode Controls – Use the shortcode builder with core layout, selector, pagination, mobile, and URL settings; Pro unlocks drawer, collapse, redirect, operator, and the full desktop layout set.
✅️ Advanced Pagination & Sorting Controls – Support advanced pagination modes, selector mapping, and Pro AJAX sorting/result-count/browser-history controls.
✅️ Modern Pro UI Variants – Upgrade for chips, button chips, steppers, modern dropdowns, rating sliders, chart price sliders, SKU search buttons, discount sliders, and calendar-style date filters.
✅️ Pro Multilingual Filter Support – Upgrade for WPML-ready option strings, translated taxonomy data, language-aware filter caches, and current-language frontend values.

🎯 Core Filtering Features:

The AJAX Product Filter for WooCommerce gives customers powerful tools to refine their search instantly. From categories, price, rating, size, attributes, and tags to stock status and custom fields, shoppers can apply multiple filters at once – without page reloads. This real-time filtering ensures a faster, smoother, and more enjoyable shopping experience that keeps customers engaged and drives more conversions.

✅️ Supercharged AJAX Filtering Engine

Experience lightning-fast product filtering with advanced AJAX technology. As customers apply filters, product listings update instantly – no full-page reloads, no delays. Just smooth, fluid filtering that keeps shoppers engaged and improves usability.

  • Real-time results Instant updates with every filter click or selection. Keep shoppers focused and prevent drop-offs with instant feedback.
  • Smooth pagination and sorting Smooth pagination and sorting without page reloads. Deliver an uninterrupted flow that makes browsing effortless.
  • Custom loader effects Maintain a consistent, branded shopping experience. Reinforce your brand while ensuring checkout stays smooth and professional.
  • Advanced pagination modes Choose number pagination, number with previous/next, load more, or infinite scroll with custom trigger selectors.
  • AJAX sorting and result counts Keep ordering controls, product counts, and product grids synchronized without page reloads.
  • Browser history step navigation Let shoppers move back and forward through filter states cleanly.

✅️ Powerful Filter Options – From Basic to Advanced

Give your customers the tools to refine their shopping journey with ease. From everyday basics to advanced search options, the AJAX Product Filter for WooCommerce ensures they find the right products faster:

  • Product Basics Filters
    Help users quickly discover what they need with simple, effective filters:
  • Filter by Price: Let shoppers set budgets and view products within their range.
  • Filter by Rating: Showcase products with top reviews for faster, trusted decisions.
  • Filter by Category, Tags, or Attributes: Narrow results by size, color, material, or custom attributes.
  • Keyword-Based Search Filter: Allow instant text-based searches across product titles.
  • Pro Search Scope & Auto Suggestions: Upgrade to search content, excerpts, SKU, tags, categories, attributes, authors, and brands with optional auto suggestions.
  • Pro Featured Product Filter: Highlight WooCommerce featured products inside AJAX filtered results.
  • Product Metadata & Pro Custom Field Filters
    Refine searches with filters based on product metadata and unique identifiers:
  • Filter by Brand – Let shoppers browse by their favorite brands.
  • Filter by Author – Perfect for books, digital products, or creator-based items.
  • Filter by SKU – Help customers quickly find specific products by code.
  • Pro Custom Meta Field Filters – Add store-specific filter options for unique product details.
  • Filter by Product ID – Let customers or staff find exact products quickly.
  • Pro Custom Taxonomies – Add AJAX filters for product taxonomies created by themes, plugins, or custom code.
  • Pro Brand Taxonomy Mapping – Auto-detect or manually choose WooCommerce brands, PWB brands, YITH brands, BeRocket brands, JetEngine brands, suppliers, manufacturers, product_brand, product_brands, pa_brand, or other product taxonomies.
  • Pro Selected Custom Taxonomies – Control exactly which product taxonomies appear in the filter form.
  • Attribute & Pro Custom Field Exclusions – Hide specific attributes or custom fields from filter generation when they should not appear on the storefront.
  • Stock & Availability Filters
    Highlight availability, promotions, and active deals with smart filtering:
  • Filter by Stock Status – Show products that are in stock, out of stock, or on backorder.
  • Filter by Sale Status – Display only items currently on sale or running promotions.
  • Filter by Discount Percentage – Showcase products with specific discounts for deal seekers.
  • Pro Product Exclusion Rules – Exclude specific products, categories, tags, brands, or custom taxonomy terms from filtered results.
  • Product Dimensions & Weight Filters
    Let customers narrow products using measurable attributes:
  • Filter by Length, Width, Height – Ideal for furniture, apparel, or equipment.
  • Filter by Weight – Useful for shipping-sensitive or size-dependent purchases.
  • Dimension Visibility & Order – Choose which dimension filters appear and arrange length, width, height, and weight in the best order for your catalog.
  • Dynamic Dimension Ranges – Use range controls for measurable product data and variation-aware values where available.
  • Date-Based Filters
    Help users discover products based on time-sensitive availability:
  • Show products from: Today, This Week, This Month, This Year.
  • Specific Date Range (From–To): Perfect for scheduling, seasonal, or limited-time products.

✅️ Multiple URL & AJAX-Based Filtering Methods

Deliver ultimate flexibility for developers and a smooth shopping experience for customers with filtering formats designed for SEO, speed, and usability.

1. Query string-based filters

  • Format: ?filters=brand,size,color
  • Example: ?filters=adidas,l,blue

2. Query String Filtering with Key Prefixes

  • Format: ?filters=1&brand=adidas&size=l&color=blue

3. Clean Permalink-Based Filtering

  • Format: /filters/brand/size/color
  • Example: /filters/adidas/large/blue

4. Permalink Filtering with Key-Value Pairs

  • Format: /filters/brand=adidas/size=l/color=blue

5. AJAX-Based Filtering (No URL Change)

  • Dynamic filtering via AJAX without changing the URL – perfect for SPAs and performance-driven stores.

6. Real-Time Dynamic AJAX Filters

  • Instant filtering as users select options – no reloads, real-time updates for a smoother UX.

Advanced URL and Redirect Controls

  • Manage filter-word prefixes, permalink prefixes, attribute-type permalinks, clean route parsing for category/tag/attribute/brand archives, and redirect settings when filtered products are missing.

✅️ Full Widget & Shortcode Support

Available Shortcodes
Easily add filters anywhere on your site using simple, flexible shortcodes:

  • [plugincy_filters] – Display the complete filter set.
  • [plugincy_filters_single name=”attribute_slug”] – Show a single, button-style filter for attributes like size or color.
  • [plugincy_filters_selected] – Highlight active filters in a clean chips-style widget.

Shortcode Builder & Attributes

  • Build [plugincy_filters] visually in the admin shortcode builder, Elementor, or Gutenberg.
  • Configure layout, mobile_responsive, product_selector, pagination_selector, per_page, category, tag, attribute, terms, and URL settings; Pro unlocks drawer side, collapsible desktop filters, close-on-apply behavior, operators, redirects, and the full six desktop layouts.
  • Use full filter, single filter, and selected filter widgets or blocks with separate style controls.

Built-in Dynamic AJAX Filter Widget & Block
Get full widget and block support with seamless integration for Elementor and the Block Editor. Unlock advanced customization options for greater design flexibility and effortless placement of filters across your store.

✅️ Mobile-Friendly & Responsive by Design

Optimized for users on the go, our filters ensure smooth shopping on any device:

  • Choose from 4 mobile friendly styles:
    • Style 1, Style 2, Popup, and Drawer
  • Touch-friendly controls for better mobile filtering experience
  • Smooth transitions and easy navigation across all screen sizes
  • Set drawer side, sidebar-on-top behavior, mobile breakpoint, and close drawer/popup after apply.

✅️ Built-in SEO Optimization

Unlike many AJAX-based plugins, Plugincy’s Product Filters for WooCommerce are SEO-ready:

  • Create SEO-friendly, crawlable permalinks enriched with relevant keywords
  • Customize SEO titles, meta descriptions, and metadata for filtered pages
  • Enable anchor-based navigation for better accessibility and rankings
  • Use AJAX-only mode when SEO isn’t needed (e.g., single-page apps)

🎨 Advanced Filter Design & UI:

Build a sleek, modern, and fully customizable filtering interface that not only enhances the user experience but also blends seamlessly with your WooCommerce store’s design.

  • Multiple UI Elements
    Offer dynamic and flexible filtering through a variety of interface options:

    • Dropdowns
    • Checkboxes
    • Radio Buttons
    • Sliders
    • Color Swatches
    • Images
    • Icons
    • Chips
    • Button Check
    • Input Fields
    • Stepper
    • Dimensions
    • Advanced Date Range
    • Advanced Rating System

  • Expanded Pro Style Variants

    • Chips, button chips, chip dropdowns, modern dropdowns, checkbox dropdowns, steppers, boxed steppers, compact steppers, and pill steppers.
    • Rating text, dynamic rating, rating chips, and rating slider layouts.
    • Input price range, chart slider, price range button, and price range card styles.
    • Color circle, color value, color swatch label, image value, button check, icon card, icon list, icon chip, icon badge, and icon-only styles.
    • Dimension range, compact dimension cards, SKU search buttons, SKU icon search, discount sliders, and modern calendar, quick-pick, dual-calendar, and stacked-list date layouts.

  • Upgraded Dropdowns with Select2
    Make filters smarter with advanced, searchable, and styled dropdowns that simplify product discovery and improve navigation.

  • New Filter Styles
    Fresh, modern, and user-friendly filter designs that adapt to your store’s theme for a cohesive look.

  • Collapsible Widget Options
    Keep filters tidy by grouping long lists into expandable sections, improving readability and navigation.

  • Customizable Filter Widgets via Elementor & Gutenberg
    Easily manage filter order, visibility, and styling directly within Elementor or the WordPress Block Editor—no coding required.

  • Advanced Term Controls
    Order terms by default, alphabetic, numeric, month/year, menu order, or count; choose ascending/descending order; include/exclude terms; choose AND/OR logic; show product counts and tooltips; and place term search in the title bar, below the title, or after all terms.

  • Filter Visibility Control
    Decide where filters appear—globally or on specific pages—for total placement control.

  • Different Filters for Different Pages
    Assign unique filter sets per page, category, or product type for tailored experiences.

  • Customizable Loader
    Choose from built-in loading animations or use Pro custom HTML/CSS for a branded touch.

⚡ Compatibility & Performance:

Deliver blazing-fast filtering without sacrificing compatibility. This plugin is optimized for speed, SEO, and seamless integration with any modern WooCommerce setup.

  • Speed Optimized
    Designed for AJAX updates with configurable selectors, cached filter data, and admin controls that help keep storefront filtering responsive.

  • Works with Custom & Premium Themes
    Seamlessly integrates with any WooCommerce-compatible theme, whether free, custom-built, or premium.

  • Built-in WordPress Widget Support
    Easily add filters to sidebars, footers, or any widget-ready area for flexible placement across your store.

  • Loop and Builder Selectors
    Set product, pagination, sorting, result-count, and product-shortcode selectors so filters work with WooCommerce archives, Elementor loops, Gutenberg blocks, shortcode grids, and custom theme loops.

  • Storefront UX Controls
    Use apply/reset behavior, default selected values, remove out-of-stock products, custom no-products text, and Select2 placeholder text controls. Pro unlocks wait cursor, overlay, smart auto scroll, AJAX pagination, AJAX sorting, and browser history step navigation.

  • Large Catalog Cache Handling
    Use database-safe cache handling, background batched cache rebuilds, Action Scheduler support, WP-Cron fallback, cache status tools, and manual refresh controls for stores with large product catalogs.

  • Accessibility and Pro Multilingual Support
    Use accessibility hardening for dynamic filter updates. Pro adds WPML-ready strings, translated taxonomy data, language-aware filter caches, and current-language frontend values.

  • Search by Text Field
    Enable users to refine results by entering keywords directly into a search field within the filter panel.

🔓 Pro Features – Unlock the Full Power:

Take your WooCommerce store to the next level with advanced filtering tools and enterprise-ready features available in the Pro version. Get more control, more flexibility, and more performance with powerful upgrades designed for serious store owners:

  • Selected Custom Taxonomy Filters
    Choose which custom product taxonomies appear in the filter form and keep storefront filters focused on the terms that matter.

  • Brand Taxonomy Auto/Manual Mapping
    Auto-detect or manually map brand filters from WooCommerce, Perfect Brands for WooCommerce, YITH, BeRocket, JetEngine, supplier, manufacturer, product_brand, product_brands, pa_brand, and other product taxonomies.

  • Featured Product Filter
    Let shoppers filter directly to WooCommerce featured products and promoted catalog items.

  • Product Exclusion Rules
    Exclude specific products, categories, tags, brands, or custom taxonomy terms from filtered AJAX results.
